name: Countdown Upset
original_name: カウントダウン・アプセット
source:
The world must be broken.
Exhausted, sick, aching, hazy, crumbling.
We're responsible.

It'll end tomorrow, apparently.
What a bleak life I've led.
It wasn't awful, but it wasn't particularly happy, either.

...you think?

The day before the world ends. While sitting at home with my little brother, I started feeling uneasy...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/7318]Freem![/url]]
translation:
世界必须破碎。
疲惫、生病、疼痛、朦胧、崩溃。
我们有责任。

看来明天就结束了
我过着多么黯淡的生活啊。
这并不可怕，但也不是特别快乐。

…你认为？

世界末日的前一天。当我和弟弟坐在家里时，我开始感到不安……

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/7318]Freem![/url]]
